findings.title: Pass the required argument to isConditionalPasskeysEnabled
findings.body: UsernameForm calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() without arguments, but the helper defined in UsernamePasswordForm requires a UserModel and has no zero-argument overload. This causes the services module to fail compilation, preventing the build and tests from running. Supply the context user or introduce a matching overload.

findings.title: Preserve passkey support when no user has been identified
findings.body: Requiring user != null disables passkeys during normal login, where context.getUser() is intentionally null until a credential identifies the user. Both authenticate() and the error challenge now skip webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(), so the initial login page receives neither the conditional-UI configuration nor the WebAuthn challenge. This regresses existing passkey logins and prevents passkey-only users from signing in after logout. The helper must allow unidentified-user authentication as well as selected-user reauthentication.
